description.narrative: Moldova - Road Rehabilitation Project: The project will rehabilitate 93 km of the M2 and R9 roads between Sarateni to a major junction north of the city of Soroca. The road works will also include small community infrastructure improvements in towns and villages along the road, as well as a feasibility study, environmental and social impact assessment, detailed design, and resettlement action plan.

title.narrative: Improving Roads to Reduce Transport Costs in Moldova

(PIA Schedule 2, 3(a))

Note:The original amount allocated to the road fund in 2015 was 1,523,748,000 lei; however a letter was received by MCC on October 21, 2015 stating that 485,000,000 lei were taken out of the road fund for other purposes. Therefore, the 485 million lei was substracted from the originally allocated amount. On May 6, 2015, when the Road Fund allocation was made official in the Monitorul Oficial, the exchange rate was 1 USD = 18.160 lei. This exchange rate was used to calculate the final actual for 2015. The final 2015 allocation was the result of the Moldovan lei collapse and the financial and political crisis in Moldova. It is an outlier compared to the clear trend of Road Fund increases (in USD) established during Compact Years 1 � 4. This is evidenced by the 2014 Road Fund allocation of $98,787,000, which was 100% of the annual target and 93% of the end of compact target.
